sentences.text: HC-KAR CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA
ORAL ORDER

The petitioner is before this Court, seeking the following prayer:
"WHEREFORE, the petitioner above named humbly pray that this Honourable Court may be pleased to quash the entire proceedings in Crime No.345/2022 of Girinagar Police Station on the file of 4th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, at Bangalore, for the offences punishable under section 170, 406, 420 of I.P.C. in the interest of justice."
2.

entities.text: 4th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, at Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Sri. Guruswamy B.S., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha,
learned Addl.SPP for respondent No.1 and have perused the material on record.
3.
Learned Addl.SPP on verification of the records would submit that the charge sheet has been filed in the case at hand.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would now seek leave of this Court to withdraw the petition and raise a challenge to the charge sheet.
NC: 2026:KHC:376 HC-KAR 5.
Liberty so sought is granted.
6. All contentions that are urged in the present petition are reserved to be urged in the petition that would be filed by the petitioner, if so filed challenging the charge sheet.
Ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
